control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.title: fire on PSV-7101 during start-up after maintenance

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was serious injury requiring hospitalisation, with 2 persons injured and 90 days lost.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PSV-7101 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. PSV-7101 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 11 September 2018 an incident occurred on PSV-7101 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during start-up after maintenance, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
